notes: Read all 4 source lines before editing. The web module is a barrel: L1 `export { XRayHeader } from './XRayHeader'`, L2 `export { XRayControls } from './XRayControls'`, L3 `export { XRayBucketChart } from './XRayBucketChart'`, L4 `export { XRayFieldsTable } from './XRayFieldsTable'`. All four exported names are preserved by the native barrel.

Self-contained native port matching the established native devtools/index.ts + charts/index.ts precedent (.ts barrels that build trees with React.createElement, since JSX requires .tsx). The four web siblings depend on a browser-only graph absent from the parity tree — lucide-react icons (Activity/Layers/Clock), @/components/data-display StatCard + TimeStamp, @/components/layout Grid, @/components/ui Select/Badge/DataTable + useSortToggle, and the @/components/charts recharts BarChart/ChartContainer stack — so each export is reimplemented with React Native primitives plus existing native components (MetricCard, the native parity Select, GlassPanel, AppText) and theme tokens.

XRayHeader (web L1): the Grid of three StatCards (Activity/Layers/Clock icons) becomes a wrapping row of the canonical native MetricCard whose accent indicator dot stands in for the lucide icon. Preserves the loading '—' guard, fmtInt(data?.total_samples ?? 0) and fmtInt(data?.unique_fields ?? 0) values, every i18n key (admin.xray.stats.samples/samplesSub/fields/fieldsSub/window/windowSub), and the `admin.xray.windowLabel.${windowSel}` window label backed by the same WINDOW_LABEL map.

XRayControls (web L2): the 3-up <Select> bar is reproduced with the native parity <Select> (Modal option list). Ports the vehicleOptions builder (empty 'Select vehicle…' option + display_name || vin || `Vehicle ${id}`), windowOptions, and bucketOptions including the BUCKET_SECS[b] >= WINDOW_SECS[windowSel] auto-disable that prevents the server-side bucket>=window 400. ALL_WINDOWS/ALL_BUCKETS literals and the Vehicle type are kept; the DOM `onChange(e.target.value)` maps to the native `onValueChange(value)` with the same `next ? Number(next) : null` vehicle parse; the per-control aria-label (vehicleAria/windowAria/bucketAria) maps to the control group accessibilityLabel.

XRayBucketChart (web L3): the recharts BarChart inside ChartContainer becomes native bars + an inline accessible data table (the ChartContainer a11y fallback). Preserves the numeric-epoch `series` memo (ts/bucket_start/count), the `!loading && series.length === 0` empty guard, the title/subtitle/ariaLabel keys, and the Bucket/Samples columns with fmtInt counts; X labels use a formatTimeLabel port of the web useDateFormat formatTime. Loading renders skeleton bars. PNG/CSV export, fullscreen and the hover Tooltip have no native analog (recorded in nativeIngestXRayBarrelCapabilities.chartExport).

XRayFieldsTable (web L4): the shared sortable DataTable becomes a native table with tap-to-sort Pressable headers. Faithfully reproduces useSortToggle('sample_count','desc') (same-key toggles direction, new key resets to desc) and the exact field/sample_count/last_seen_at/value_kind comparator with the asc/desc dir multiplier, the mono field cell, fmtInt sample counts, a relative last-seen label (web `<TimeStamp format="relative" />`), the formatValueKind() Kind chip (web Badge variant="neutral"), and the loading/empty messages (admin.xray.fields.loading/empty). DataTable pagination + column menu + mobileColumns are simplified to the full sorted list (recorded in nativeIngestXRayBarrelCapabilities.tablePagination).

Types + helpers reuse the native single source of truth: IngestXRayResponse/Window/Bucket/FieldStat/BucketPoint and formatValueKind are imported from the already-ported web-parity api/hooks/useIngestXRay; Vehicle from web-parity api/types; SelectOption from the native Select. fmtInt is ported inline from web lib/numberFormat (safeNumber guard, 0 decimals) matching the sibling EntryDrawer port. i18n intent preserved via a native t(key, fallback, vars?) shim keeping every web key + English fallback and {{var}} interpolation. No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, lucide-react, or old web UI components are imported.
